event: During the second act, Pearl watches Colette's throat from the prompt-side wing.

memory.fact: The prompt-side wing is the backstage area where Pearl watches the show with her dress kit.

event: Colette sings her solo lit gold under the gels, chin tipped back, her neck taut and luminous.

memory.fact: The Company performed a multi-act show with a featured solo for its prima.

event: Pearl loves her for her beauty, and aches to have it off Colette and onto herself.

memory.fact: Pearl is obsessed with beauty.
Pearl thinks about beautiful things the way other people pray.
Pearl experiences beautiful things with worshipful, helpless hunger.

event: Pearl tells the reader they may stop reading now; they will learn nothing kinder.
Kit on her shoulder, needle threaded from an act-one hem emergency, she lets herself be happy.

memory.fact: Pearl's work is the dress kit, the threaded needle, and hem and strap repairs on the fly.
Pearl is a young woman who works as a wardrobe assistant at a ballet and theatre company.

event: Everyone trusts sweet Pearl, the wardrobe assistant who means every compliment she gives.

memory.fact: Pearl presents as sweet, cheerful, early and helpful: Sweet little Pearl.
Pearl is genuinely liked and trusted.

event: She never lies about loving them; she only keeps quiet that she means to take it.

memory.fact: Pearl's warmth is not faked; she really does love the people she tends.
Pearl never has to lie about loving them; she just doesn't tell them the second part.
The second part is that Pearl intends to take from the people she tends.

event: Pearl chose her own name at sixteen, shedding her mother's soft forgettable one.

memory.fact: Pearl chose the name Pearl herself at sixteen.
Pearl discarded the name her mother gave her.
Pearl's given name was soft and forgettable, a name like a wet napkin.

event: She tells how a pearl is made: shine built layer on layer over a speck of filth.

memory.fact: A pearl forms when a speck of filth or a parasite gets inside a creature that can't expel it.
The creature buries the flaw under coat after coat of shine.
In the end the flaw is the whole reason for the pearl's beauty.
Pearl believes you become gorgeous by burying what you started as.

event: She always meant to become that, and tonight the world has handed her the tools.

memory.fact: Pearl says she always knew she would do this to herself.

event: During the bows, Mr. Aldous, who funds half the season, finds her in the wing.

memory.fact: Mr. Aldous is a patron of the theatre company who funds half the season.
Mr. Aldous sought Pearl out backstage during the bows.
Mr. Aldous looks at the dancers like a man at a buffet who's been told not to touch.
Mr. Aldous does not look at Pearl that way.
Pearl reads herself as too pretty to be staff and too sweet to be prey to men like Mr. Aldous.

event: He presses a glass of something gold into her hand that she never asked for.

memory.fact: Mr. Aldous pressed an unrequested glass of gold liquor into Pearl's hand.

event: He calls hers the only honest face back here; she says she wants everyone wonderful.

memory.fact: Mr. Aldous told Pearl she was the only honest face backstage, who just wants them to do well.
Mr. Aldous's breath is like oak and money.

event: She touches his sleeve, he glows, and she admires his magnificent watch.

memory.fact: Pearl charmed Mr. Aldous with a touch on the sleeve, an instance of her Allure.
Pearl noted Mr. Aldous's magnificent watch.
Mr. Aldous had no idea what was beside him in Pearl.

event: The System rates her Allure 14.0, where ordinary is 10.0; doors open for her.
Aldous wanders off to be wonderful at someone else, and Pearl drinks his gold drink.
Colette finishes her final bow, and the house comes up roaring.
Pearl warns that in about forty minutes she will kill Colette, and wants her known first.

memory.fact: Colette's beauty was the standard Pearl measured her own insufficiency against.
Pearl calls that measuring a kind of love most people never get from anybody.

event: Colette carries her beauty like weather; Pearl is pretty the way a knife is.

memory.fact: Pearl is very pretty, pretty the way a knife is pretty, all edge and intention.

event: Colette's Celerity lets her change shape in the air; Pearl's is 11.0, a girl hurrying.

memory.fact: Colette could change her mind in the air, landing a different shape than she left the ground.
Colette's changes in the air came faster than the decision should have traveled.
Pearl coveted Colette's grace, the body that changes its mind in the air.
Pearl watched Colette dance from the wing for many nights.

event: Offstage, Colette sees Tamsin, a terrified first-season corps girl, crying in the far wing.

memory.fact: Tamsin is a new corps dancer, eighteen, in her first season with the company.
Tamsin is terrified.
After the show Tamsin cried very quietly backstage, certain no one could see.
Forty people were backstage while Tamsin cried, and nobody saw.

event: Colette crosses the backstage, takes Tamsin's wet face in her hands, and makes her laugh.

memory.fact: Colette Vane crossed the backstage and took Tamsin's face in both hands to reassure her.

event: She tells her a cue light dead since intermission made her miss her entrance, not her.

memory.fact: Colette privately told Tamsin her missed entrance came from a cue light dead since intermission.
Colette told Tamsin it wasn't her fault, which unlocked Tamsin's distress.

event: Colette reads rooms like sheet music and sees everyone, but never once sees Pearl.

memory.fact: Colette read emotions and secrets; she read rooms like sheet music and saw everyone.
Above all, Pearl coveted Colette's gift for reading people.
Colette read everyone, yet while she lived never perceived Pearl's true nature.

event: Within twenty minutes the company drains out into the cold, and the work-lights come down.

memory.fact: The house empties within about twenty minutes of the final bow.
After the show the big stage rig clunks down to the work-lights.
The work-lights are low amber lights that make everything look like it's remembering itself.

event: Colette takes Pearl to the mirrored studio off the green room to break down her costume.

memory.fact: The Company has a green room, and a mirror studio off it.
The mirror studio is walled entirely in mirror, and its light is kind.
Colette liked to break down her heavy costumes in the mirror studio after shows, with Pearl's help.

event: Pearl says she planned nothing tonight: no knife, no scheme, only a sewing kit.

memory.fact: Pearl had not planned to kill that night, only eventually, as a vague horizon.
Pearl carried only a sewing kit and a crush on the idea of being more than she was.

event: Among a hundred reflections, she works the bodice hooks down Colette's spine.

memory.fact: The power surfaced as Pearl helped Colette out of the act-three bodice.

event: Colette tells Pearlie she should be dancing, with a better line than her own.

memory.fact: Colette was warm and generous to Pearl and called her Pearlie.
Colette praised Pearl's line: better than mine, she said.
Colette, speaking to Pearl's reflection, told Pearl she should be dancing.

event: As Colette's throat works around the words, a lens drops over Pearl's eye.

memory.fact: With the hum, a sense like a jeweler's loupe drops over Pearl's perception.

event: She can taste Colette: sweet beauty, bright humming quickness, a cool minty seeing.

memory.fact: The loupe lets Pearl taste which of a victim's traits are finest.
Pearl's appetite, the hum, rose, and she tasted Colette's finest qualities.

event: A calm, total certainty comes over her: she could just take it.

memory.fact: A calm certainty told Pearl she could just take it.

event: Pearl is delighted: she always could, she only lacked the hands.
She feels no dread, only the giddy fizz of a child at the top of the high board.

memory.fact: Pearl felt no fear or dread at the kill, only a giddy, fizzing, about-to exhilaration.
Pearl's tremble at her first kill was a crush's tremble, not a coward's.
At her first kill Pearl's heart pounded finally, not no.

event: Her French-forged wardrobe shears sit in the kit at her hip.

memory.fact: Pearl's tools are wardrobe shears: heavy, bright and French-forged.
Pearl's shears are sharp enough to halve a silk ribbon by their own weight.
Pearl takes very good care of her tools.

event: The lens tells her she may keep only one thing: one deliberate theft per life.

memory.fact: Acquisition lets Pearl permanently take one of a victim's finest traits on killing them.

event: She knows then that she will be very, very good at this.
Colette chatters about the spring program, arms lifted, throat tipped back and trusting.
Pearl says, "Colette."
Colette meets Pearl's eyes in the mirror and, for a quarter of a second, finally sees her.

memory.fact: Colette finally read Pearl a quarter-second too late.

event: Pearl smiles at her, and means it.
Watching in the glass, Pearl cuts Colette's throat with the shears, fast as a change in the air.

memory.fact: Pearl cut Colette's throat with her shears as the mirrors showed a hundred of each of them.
Colette Vane was murdered by Pearl after a performance.
Pearl learned from Colette how to change in the air, and used that lesson in killing her.
Pearl's feeling for Colette Vane went from worship to murder.

event: Red sheets down the gold-lit cream; Pearl thinks they never looked so good together.
A click like a key turning in a lock, and the lens opens all the way.

memory.fact: On the kill comes a click.

event: Colette, slumped and quiet in Pearl's arms, stops being a person and becomes a display.

memory.fact: After the click the System surfaces the victim's three most notable traits as a plain readout.
The kill triggered Pearl's first Acquisition appraisal.

event: Kneeling in the red, grinning, Pearl reads the card like a love letter.
The hard part is the choosing: she may take exactly one home, and the rest is lost.

memory.fact: Pearl may take exactly one of the three traits.

event: Appraisal of Colette Vane, unpowered; Pearl: Might 8, Vit 9, Cel 11, Acu 12, Will 10, Allure 14.

memory.fact: Pearl's Onset power is Acquisition.
Colette had no Onset power.

event: Offered: Allure 16.0 (14.0 to 15.6), Celerity 15.0 (11.0 to 12.5), Acuity 13.0 (12.0 to 13.3).

memory.fact: Colette was unpowered, so the three traits offered were her top three attributes.

event: The card says: select one, one only.
Pearl crouches beside Colette and lets her eyes wander the menu only she can see.
One of the three doors glows brighter than its neighbours.
Her finger hovers over the light; this will be the best part of her life, every time.
